headline: Mistakes to Steer Clear Of When Upgrading Your Shower or Tub
articleBody: Upgrading your shower or tub can really refresh your bathroom, but there are a few common blunders to avoid. One biggie is choosing a product without checking lead times or room dimensions. You don't want to be stuck with a disassembled bathroom waiting for a special order. Another frequent mistake is overlooking waterproofing. This isn't an area to cut corners on; hidden water damage is a nightmare! Folks also often forget to plan for needed plumbing or electrical relocations. Moving valves or adding a new light fixture can change the scope significantly. Lastly, failing to confirm what accessories or trim parts must be purchased in advance can cause delays and extra trips to the store. Before you dive in, consider if your upgrade involves removing a tub, converting to a shower, or changing any underlying plumbing or electrical. These are situations where professional help becomes super important to ensure everything is done correctly and safely.
